mergedParams.userDescription: Text subtly changing perspective, as if on a 3D plane. typo kinetics for titles/captions/other text..

prompts.prompt: Create a 3D perspective shift typography preset where text appears to rotate on an invisible Y-axis, simulating a camera dolly around 3D text. Think of it like a turntable shot in video editing where the text slowly reveals different angles. The text should start facing slightly left, rotate through center (full frontal), and continue to a slight right angle, creating a smooth arc of perspective change. Use CSS transform perspective and rotateY for the 3D effect, with subtle changes in letter-spacing to enhance the depth illusion. The animation should feel like a professional title sequence with cinematic weight.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center' containing a TextAtom. Apply perspective: 1000px to container style. Use generic effects array with rotateY keyframes from -25deg to 25deg over full duration. Add subtle scaleX animation from 0.95 to 1.05 to 0.95 to simulate perspective distortion. Include letterSpacing effect from -0.02em to 0.02em synchronized with rotation. Use ease-in-out easing for smooth, professional motion. Consider adding a subtle text-shadow that shifts horizontally to enhance 3D illusion. Performance: use transform-style: preserve-3d and will-change: transform for GPU acceleration.

prompts.prompt: Design a multi-layered perspective text animation inspired by parallax scrolling in video editing. Split the text into individual words using caption data, each word existing on a different depth plane. As the virtual camera moves, words at different depths move at different speeds - foreground words move faster, background words slower. This creates a rich depth effect similar to 2.5D animation in After Effects. Words should also scale based on their Z-depth, with closer words appearing larger.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden' containing multiple TextAtom components for each word from caption data. Position words absolutely with varying z-index values. Use translateZ in combination with translateX for parallax motion. Closer words (z-index 3-5): translateX from -20% to 20%, scale 1.2. Middle words (z-index 2): translateX from -10% to 10%, scale 1.0. Far words (z-index 1): translateX from -5% to 5%, scale 0.8. Apply perspective: 800px to container. Add opacity gradients - farther words slightly faded (0.7-0.9 opacity). Use spring easing for organic motion. Consider blur effect on far words for depth of field.

prompts.prompt: Build a tilting plane typography effect where text appears to be printed on a physical card that tilts in 3D space. Imagine a title card being held and gently rotated to catch the light - the text should tilt on both X and Y axes simultaneously, creating a dynamic reading angle. Add a subtle reflection or shine effect that moves across the text as it tilts, simulating studio lighting hitting the surface at different angles.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative flex items-center justify-center' containing nested BaseLayout with 'relative' for the card, then TextAtom inside. Apply transform-style: preserve-3d and perspective: 1200px to outer container. Use generic effects with combined rotateX (from -15deg to 15deg) and rotateY (from -20deg to 20deg) with sinusoidal timing offset. Add ::before pseudo-element via style prop for shine effect using linear-gradient with animation. Shine: animate gradient position from left: -100% to left: 200%. Use CSS filter for subtle drop-shadow that shifts based on tilt angle. Timing: 4-6 second loop with ease-in-out. Consider adding backgroundColor animation for subtle lighting changes.

prompts.prompt: Develop a perspective zoom typography preset that simulates a camera pushing through 3D text. Start with text appearing far away and small, then dramatically push through it as if the camera is flying through the letters. This creates a dramatic title reveal often used in action movie trailers. The text should grow beyond the viewport boundaries as it approaches, with individual letters having slight timing offsets for a more dynamic feel.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-center' containing TextAtom or multiple TextAtoms for letter-level control. Use translateZ animation from -2000px to 500px combined with scale from 0.1 to 3.0. Apply perspective: 500px for dramatic depth. If using word-level caption data, offset each word's animation start by 0.1s. Add opacity fade from 0 to 1 in first 20%, then 1 to 0 in last 30% as text passes camera. Use exponential easing (cubic-bezier) for acceleration feel. Add motion blur via CSS filter during fastest movement phase. Performance: use transform3d() and will-change.

prompts.prompt: Create an isometric text rotation preset where typography exists in an isometric 3D grid, rotating through different viewing angles like architectural visualization software. The text should snap between different isometric positions (front, left-iso, right-iso, back) with smooth transitions. This creates a technical, blueprint-like aesthetic perfect for tech or engineering content.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full flex items-center justify-center' with TextAtom. Apply transform: rotateX(30deg) rotateY(45deg) for isometric base. Use generic effects with stepped keyframes: 0-25%: rotateY(45deg), 25-50%: rotateY(-45deg), 50-75%: rotateY(-135deg), 75-100%: rotateY(45deg). Combine with consistent rotateX(30deg). Add grid background via containerProps.style with repeating-linear-gradient for isometric grid lines. Include subtle scale bounce at each rotation stop using spring easing. Consider adding text-stroke for technical drawing aesthetic. Use CSS custom properties for rotation angles to maintain consistency.

prompts.prompt: Design a folding perspective typography animation inspired by paper folding and origami. Text should appear to unfold from a compressed state, with each word or letter folding out from different angles. Think of it as kinetic typography meeting paper craft - each text element rotates on its transform-origin as if hinged. The unfolding should cascade across the text creating a wave-like reveal.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with individual TextAtom components for each word from caption data. Set transform-origin for each word: alternating 'left center' and 'right center'. Initial state: rotateY(90deg) for left-origin, rotateY(-90deg) for right-origin. Animate to rotateY(0deg) with staggered delays (index * 0.15s). Add scaleY from 0.8 to 1.0 for paper-thin initial appearance. Apply perspective: 1000px to container. Include drop-shadow filter that intensifies as elements unfold. Use backface-visibility: hidden for clean rotation. Consider adding slight rotateX wobble at end for paper settling effect. Timing: ease-out with slight bounce.

prompts.prompt: Build a cylindrical text wrap effect where typography appears wrapped around an invisible cylinder, rotating continuously like a news ticker in 3D space. As the cylinder rotates, text curves around it, appearing larger at the front and smaller as it moves to the sides and back. This creates a carousel-like effect perfect for cycling through multiple text elements.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with 'relative w-full h-full' containing multiple TextAtom elements positioned absolutely. Calculate positions using sin/cos for circular distribution. Each text element gets translateZ based on cos(angle) and translateX based on sin(angle). Multiply by radius (e.g., 200px). Apply continuous rotateY animation to container from 0deg to 360deg. Add opacity based on Z position - front text full opacity, back text 0.3 opacity. Scale text based on Z depth: scale(0.7) to scale(1.3). Use perspective: 800px on container. For smooth infinite rotation, set animation-iteration-count: infinite with linear timing. Consider blur for distant text elements.

prompts.prompt: Create a perspective flutter effect where text appears to be printed on fabric or paper caught in wind. The typography should wave and ripple with realistic cloth physics, creating organic movement. Different parts of the text should have slightly different wave phases, making it feel like a banner fluttering. Add subtle perspective changes as the material tilts toward and away from the viewer.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with TextAtom, or split into character-level TextAtoms for more complex motion. Use CSS custom properties for wave animation with sin() calculations. Apply multiple transform animations: rotateX with sine wave pattern (-5deg to 5deg), rotateY with offset sine wave (-8deg to 8deg), and subtle translateZ for depth. Add skewX animation for fabric stretch effect. Use filter: blur() that increases slightly at wave peaks. Implement staggered animation delays based on character index (index * 0.05s). Apply perspective: 1200px to container. Use ease-in-out with slight spring tension. Consider adding text-shadow that shifts with the wave for enhanced depth.

prompts.prompt: Develop a perspective flip book animation where text transitions through different viewing angles as if pages are being turned. Each 'page turn' reveals the text from a new perspective - flat, tilted left, tilted right, tilted up, tilted down. This creates a dynamic reading experience reminiscent of motion graphics in educational content. Include subtle page-turn physics with acceleration and deceleration.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout container with TextAtom. Use generic effects with segmented keyframe animations. Segments: 0-20% (flat), 20-40% (rotateY to -30deg with rotateX 10deg), 40-60% (back to flat), 60-80% (rotateY to 30deg with rotateX -10deg), 80-100% (return to flat). Add scaleZ for depth during turns. Include transform-origin adjustments during turns for realistic pivot points. Apply perspective: 1000px. Add box-shadow that shifts during page turns. Use cubic-bezier easing with different curves for each segment - ease-in for start of turn, ease-out for completion. Consider adding slight bounce-back at each turn completion using spring physics.

prompts.prompt: Design a holographic perspective shift effect where text appears as a 3D hologram rotating in space. The text should have multiple semi-transparent layers slightly offset in Z-space, creating a volumetric appearance. As it rotates, add chromatic aberration and scan lines to enhance the sci-fi holographic aesthetic. The perspective should shift to reveal the layered depth of the hologram.
prompts.technicalSpecs: Structure: BaseLayout with multiple TextAtom layers (3-4 copies) positioned absolutely with different translateZ values (-10px, 0px, 10px, 20px). Each layer has different opacity (0.3, 0.6, 0.9, 0.6) and slight color shift using CSS filters (hue-rotate). Apply continuous rotateY animation (0 to 360deg) and subtle rotateX oscillation (-10deg to 10deg). Add perspective: 600px for pronounced depth. Include ::after pseudo-element for scan lines using repeating linear gradient animated on translateY. Apply mix-blend-mode: screen for holographic glow. Add chromatic aberration using text-shadow with red/cyan offsets. Use animation-timing-function: linear for smooth rotation. Consider adding glitch effect at intervals using transform: skew and filter: brightness flickers.
